blocks.label: after his win over Cobolli
blocks.text: It was a difficult match for me, because I had to see how I was going to feel on the court. Today's match, for me, was an important match because we were testing myself. I'm proud about the level that I'm playing today and the way that I'm feeling.

blocks.label: on playing aggressively while protecting his thigh
blocks.text: I just felt great on court today. I try not to move that much, I try to be aggressive, to dominate the match as much as I can … I could do it. I tried to play as aggressive as I can, hitting the ball as hard as I could, trying not to move that much. I try not to go too hard with myself physically, so I just tried to play really hard, really strong, and aggressive, and I think I could do it. So I'm just happy about it. I'm looking forward to tomorrow.

blocks.label: on recovering physically for the semi-final
blocks.text: The challenge is no longer on the court, it is off the court, to do whatever it takes to be in a good shape, to feel physically ready for a battle tomorrow. It's going to be a really important half a day that I have ahead of me with my team, with my physio, with the doctor. Recovering is the most important thing now, we'll see how I feel tomorrow.

blocks.label: on his growing confidence
blocks.text: The way that I felt on the court today was incredible … I'm getting more confident after every match. I'm just really happy that I'm getting more confident in the way that I'm hitting the ball, the way that I'm seeing what's going on in the match and after that trying to find solutions.

blocks.label: on managing the injury scare before the match
blocks.text: Yesterday was a really important day for me, to be honest. Obviously I felt something in the last match. Yesterday with the test, we decided not to practice, to rest. We went to have a walk, chill. And getting treatment morning, afternoon with my physio, this morning once again, really careful. Doing, I'm going to say, as best as we can the things off the court to be ready and to be in a good shape for this match. I'm trying to learn from these moments. I'm trying to know myself a little bit better. I think these kinds of moments help you a lot to know yourself much better.

blocks.label: on supporting his friend Cobolli
blocks.text: I'm here, whatever he needs, to talk, whatever it is, I'm here for him, because he's a great friend … We're going to see more about Flavio Cobolli in the future. I'm going to say that, because I'm sure about it.
